20.text: Ettha “sāsanā nāma gogalaṭṭhitaṁ lambamānacammalomasaṅghātarūpaṁ galakambalaṁ, sā ādi yesaṁ gavaṅgānanti sāsanādīni, sāsanānaṅguṭṭhakakudakhuravisāṇādigavaṅgāni, tāni assa paṭipiṇḍassa atthīti sāsanādimā, paṭipiṇḍo, tasmiṁ paṭipiṇḍe gopatirūpake”ti attho veditabbo.
Imassa pana sādhippāyo attho moggallānabyākhyāyaṁ catutthakaṇḍe (120) suttabyākhyāto gahetabbo.
